patterns: What are the courses offered at SV University for undergraduate students?
Are there any special programs like B.Tech + M.Tech or integrated courses?
responses: SVU offers UG, PG, and Doctoral programs in various disciplines including Engineering, Sciences, Arts, and Management. Please visit https://svuniversity.edu.in/academics/ for detailed info.

UG degrees: BEd, BA, BSc (Hons), BCom/BBA, BCA, BPharm, Law (BA-LLB, BBA-LLB, BCom-LLB), BTech (CSE, ECE, EEE, Mechanical, Civil, Chemical), B.Voc in Food Processing, Dairying & Animal Husbandry, Horticulture.
PG degrees: MA, MSc, MEd, MPhil, MTech, MPharm, MBA, MCA, MS in many specializations.

Integrated Courses: B.Tech (EEE)+M.Tech (Power Systems), B.Tech (ECE)+M.Tech (Signal Processing), B.Tech (CSE)+M.Tech (CSE), B.Tech (Civil)+M.Tech (Structural/Env. Engg), B.Tech (Mech)+M.Tech (Industrial/Production), Integrated BA LLB / BBA LLB / BCom LLB.
Distance Education: BA, BCom, BSc, MA, MCom, MSc, MBA, MLISc, MSW,MS in Data science, PG Diplomas.

patterns: Can I change my stream after joining?
Is there any possibility to change stream?
How many subjects are there in the first year?
How often are the exams conducted?
Are internal marks added to final marks?
Is there a system for revaluation?
responses: Stream change post-admission is limited and subject to rules and availability—apply early to the college office.
Typically 4–6 subjects per semester in first year plus labs/practical components.
Semester end exams occur twice a year, with continuous internal assessments.
Lab exams are scheduled by departments with internal/external examiners.
SVU follows CBCS with credit system and grade points as per UGC guidelines.
Internal assessment (tests, assignments, attendance) contributes to final marks.

patterns: How much are the course fees?
Are there any additional costs apart from tuition?
Is there any fee concession for SC/ST/OBC students?
Are there any scholarships provided by SV University?
How can I apply for government scholarships?
responses: Tuition fee varies by programme/college; contact your accounts office or visit https://svuniversity.edu.in for details.
Additional costs include lab, library, hostel, mess and exam fees.
SC/ST/BC/EWS concessions and state fee reimbursement schemes are available.
Government scholarships and departmental awards are available; apply via the e-Pass portal with institute verification.

patterns: Is hostel facility available for boys and girls?
Is hostel food good and hygienic?
responses: Yes, SV University provides hostels for both boys and girls. Women: 9 blocks, Men: several including RS Hostel. Visit https://svuniversity.edu.in/hostels/.
Wi-Fi is available in academic buildings; hostel Wi-Fi depends on block provisioning.
Hostel messes function under student committees; hygiene is overseen by the hostel office.

responses: Classes start dates vary by programme—check with your department.
Bring originals and copies of certificates, TC, migration, rank card, caste/income certificates, Aadhar, photos and ID proofs.
Apply to your college office for a bonafide certificate.
Transfers require migration certificate/NOC—apply to COE/Admissions.

Originals are verified and usually returned after verification.
Apply with prescribed form and fee to COE/Admissions for migration certificate.
Report lost ID, apply at college office with reissue fee.
Marks memos are issued by COE; consolidated transcripts available on request.
